name: SetCheckboxState
label: Set Checkbox State
description: Checks or unchecks a checkbox UI element by searching for it by name within a parent element.

fields.name: IdentificationObjectPath
fields.label: UI Element Identification Path
fields.description: The parent UI element where the checkboxes are located.

fields.name: CheckboxNameOrIndex
fields.label: Checkbox Name or Index
fields.description: The name or zero-based index of the checkbox to set.

fields.name: Checked
fields.label: Desired State
fields.description: Whether to check (true) or uncheck (false) the checkbox.

fields.name: MaxWaitTime
fields.label: Max Wait Time (seconds)
fields.description: Maximum time to wait to find the UI element (in seconds).

fields.name: WasStateChanged
fields.label: Was State Changed
fields.description: True if the checkbox state was changed successfully, otherwise false.
